description.default: Right-click any text to translate between Chinese and English. Uses the free Microsoft Edge endpoint by default (reachable in mainland China), with Google as an automatic fallback. Youdao API is also supported.
description.zh-CN: 右键选中文字即可翻译中文与英文。默认走微软 Edge 免费引擎（国内可直连），失败自动切换 Google，也支持有道智云。
